title: BENZEMA'S AL HILAL REPLACEMENT WAS ANNOUNCED THE DAY BEFORE HE LEFT
description:
Six months. A £51m replacement. And a France squad without him.

Karim Benzema spent six months at Al Hilal. A 51 million pound replacement was announced the day before he left. That's not a hint. That's a billboard.

Lyon called a return more noise than reality. Mourinho dug up his 2010 cat story. Some stories have nine lives.

Then there's France. Zidane says he adores Karim and calls him the best French striker in history. Five Champions League titles and 25 trophies at Real Madrid back that up. Yet Zidane picked a France squad without him. Adoration from a distance.

So the best French striker in history will watch from home. Probably from a very nice flat.

Was Zidane right to leave him out? Make your case in the comments.
